products.product_description: Regalo Bakery: "Spanish Rolls"[UPC#78253230919]: Packaged in a clear plastic bag, containing eight pieces, with a net weight of 14 ounces. This product contains: eggs, wheat, milk, soy, and artificial food coloring (Red 40 & 3, Yellow 5 & 6)
products.reason_for_recall: Regalo Bakery is recalling Spanish Rolls due to undeclared eggs, wheat, milk, soy, and artificial food coloring (Red 40 & 3, Yellow 5 & 6).
